speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, I am Dr. Agent. To begin investigating the cause of your acute diarrhea, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms and what do they look like?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Levofloxacin-associated *C. difficile* infection.

Given the history of recent levofloxacin treatment for pneumonia and the onset of frequent watery diarrhea with cramping, this clinical picture strongly suggests a *Clostridioides difficile* infection. I will request a stool test to confirm this diagnosis immediately.

REQUEST TEST: Stool_C difficile_toxin_assay
